description: Per-NF-letter shift accounting for the NH_n basis of H_n(q). For each w ∈ S_n (n ≤ 5) we compute the seminormal pole order at q = 0 of T_w, the naive per-letter upper bound (= ℓ(w)), and the GB-reduction count = ℓ(w) − pole_order. Validates the cycle-additive DP probe upper bound and cross-checks the torus-knot Coxeter element against alpha_shift_torus.py.
caveats: The 'GB reduction count' is defined here as ℓ(w) − pole_order, i.e. the by-definition gap between the per-letter upper bound and the actual seminormal pole order. It does not correspond to an explicit GS reduction trace; the witness merely shows the gap is non-negative on every w ∈ S_n for n ∈ {2, 3, 4, 5}.
